parameters.name: AutoDeleteExecutions
parameters.description: Specifies whether to delete the executions related to the template when deleting the template.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The template name. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and can be up to 200 characters in length. The name cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, or ALICLOUD.
